actions.text: The Command Post builds itself. You are the guns. Walk your Field Officer onto a coloured pad to draw a squad.
Hold the line — then break it. You win by putting THEIR Command Post down, north of the ridges.
Pads, left to right: Rifles · Flak · Strike · Gunship · Field Aid · Siege
Lose your last man and you pick again — so pick what the last wave killed you with.
Squad lost. Draw another.

Squad lost. Draw another.
Squad lost. Draw another.
Squad lost. Draw another.
Rifles — reaches both layers. Never wrong, never decisive.
Flak — tears down anything airborne, helpless against boots.
Strike — fast skiffs, murder on the ground, blind to the air.
Gunship — hits everything, and there are only two of them.
Field Aid — keeps other squads standing. Cannot kill anything.
Siege — lobbed shells, wide splash, useless up close or upward.

Wave 1. Contact — light infantry on the west road.
Wave 2. Second wave. Still boots.
Wave 3. Air contact. Somebody had better have flak.
Wave 4. Mixed wave inbound.
Wave 5. They are committing now.
Wave 6. Heavy air. Keep the guns pointed up.
Wave 7. Gunship in the formation — hit it before it settles.
Wave 8. All three lanes.
Wave 9. They want the Command Post this time.
Wave 10. Everything they have left is moving.
Wave 11. Hold. Just hold.
Wave 12. Last wave. All of it.
The Command Post is gone. Nothing left to support.

triggers.name: The enemy Command Post has fallen

actions.text: Their Command Post is down. It is over.

triggers.name: Hand over to the endless schedule

actions.text: No more scheduled waves — they are just coming now. Take their base.
